name: missive
description: Missive — plateforme d'email marketing (monorepo sans workspaces : chaque app a ses propres node_modules)

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix apps/api install && npm --prefix apps/web install && npm --prefix apps/mobile install && npm --prefix apps/site install
scripts.dev: npx --yes concurrently@10.0.6 --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web --prefix-colors magenta,cyan "npm --prefix apps/api run dev" "npm --prefix apps/web run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/api run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/web run build && npm --prefix apps/mobile run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/site run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix apps/api run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/web run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/mobile run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/site run typecheck
